notes.title: Update v1.500
notes.notes:
Hello VR gamers !

1) At the time of development of this game the Oculus Rift was not released yet.
That is why it was built for HTC Vive only for long time.

Since there are some Oculus players out there that would like to play this game, we had decided to push a patch that resolves compatibility issues with Oculus.

2) The TOP score function was not working, because of a typo introduced in previous version, now it works :) 

enjoy !

notes.title: Update v1.400a
notes.notes:
This minor patch brings a performance update for low-mid end VGA's
Keep your eyes out for Egg Time 2 info's which will be available within few weeks.

enjoy.

enjoy !

notes.title: Update v1.300b
notes.notes:
this small patch is fixing a big issue, stuck animation at first level start that caused inability to play the game.
This was included by mistake in the previous patch (1.300a).
Issue is now resolved.

notes.title: Update v1.300
notes.notes:
Hello VR gamers !

This new exciting game update brings following enhancments to the game:

 enhanced lighting
 enhanced collision detecion
 adjusted physics (resolved issues with eggs sometimes flying out of the basket)
 adjusted ground hit detection
 fixed inability to save TOP SCORE for some users
 fixed inability to unlock already finished levels for some users
 overal optimizations, users with less powerful hardware can also enjoy the game 


You can expect more exciting news in coming days.

enjoy !

notes.title: Future update info
notes.notes:
Hi fellow VR players,

a big performance update is going to be released next week, lowering the requirements of your hardware.
Issues reported will be resolved, like inability to set TOP SCORE or select already unlocked levels in some cases.
Also some collision systems were adjusted so they can work more reliably.
There will be also a big announcement along with the patch, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Performance update (v1.100)
notes.notes:
Hello VR enthusiasts,

the game was patched with new performance update, you can expect:

1) better graphical fidelity
2) lower HW requirements
3) eggs wont fall thru the basket anymore
4) the paddles and bat have now more realistic collisions.

{edit , working on massive upgrade, keep an eye out for v1.2}

Enjoy

notes.title: Instructions update (v1.003)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

from info that I had gathered over past few days it is almost certain that the vast majority of players did not use "Egg Time" and "Egg Frenzy" ability.

To address the issue there were new instruction items added to the game main menu.
I hope that it will help players to figure out the controls much more easier.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346603/3186c69fba5c8d419d46e49c14b748de6c7e8b26.jpg

enjoy !
